fields.gemini: On 19.03.2018 at 04.10 PM one Erick Ekka (35), S/O-Francis Ekka of village Jharbeda (Hetposh), PS-Raiboga, Dist- Sundargarh appeared at PS and submitted a written report being scribed by one Sentus Kiro to the effect that on 04.03.2018 at about 06.00 PM while his elder brother Ajit Ekka was going to his house by food on the village road of Jharbeda, Bhuyan basti one Honda Activa Scootey bearing regd. No. OD14M 3112 came in high speed from his back side and dashed against him. As a result he fell down on the ground and sustained head injury. Then he was shifted to RGH, Rourkela and subsequently he was shifted to Burla Hospital for treatment. On 05.30.2018 at about 05.00 am Ajit Ekka was died while undergoing treatment at Burla Hospital. The P.M exainatioon of the dead body of Ajit Ekka was conducted by the Burla OP and then brought the dead body to their native house for funeral. The accident took place due to rash and negligence driving of the Scootey rider Aswini Majhi of village Khairbahal. An U.D. Case was registered at Burla OP and as he has no knowledge about the law he reported the matter at PS in dealy.On this report I registered PS case No.19 dt. 19.03.2018, U/S-279/304 (AA) IPC and directed ASI G.K.Banchhur to take up investigation of the case.
